title: DSINC beyond Heston: the 3/2 and other non-affine stochastic-volatility models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28847v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper extends the damped-sinc (DSINC) method for American options beyond the affine Heston class to general one-factor stochastic-volatility models. We show that the collapse identity, which reduces the early-exercise integral to a single spectral integral, remains valid for these models. Damping between zero and one is admissible whenever the discounted spot is a nonnegative local martingale. An It\^o transformation of the volatility factorizes the conditional characteristic function and identifies a natural coordinate for approximating the exercise boundary. The 3/2 model admits closed-form joint transforms in terms of Kummer functions, while uncorrelated SABR admits a Bessel representation. When a practical closed-form transform is unavailable, the required volatility integral is computed directly by solving one backward equation per frequency, without a grid in the log-price. translated_abstract: 本文将用于美式期权的阻尼sinc（DSINC）方法从仿射Heston类扩展到一般的单因子随机波动率模型。我们证明，将提前行权积分化简为单一谱积分的塌缩恒等式对这些模型依然成立。只要贴现标的价格是非负局部鞅，取0到1之间的阻尼因子就是可行的。对波动率施加Itô变换可使条件特征函数因式分解，并确定了用于近似行权边界的自然坐标。3/2模型具有以Kummer函数表示的闭式联合变换，而不相关的SABR模型则具有Bessel表示。当实用的闭式变换不可得时，所需的波动率积分可通过在每个频率上求解一个倒向方程直接计算，无需在对数价格上建立网格。通过已知的波动率坐标变换，此……
tldr: 本文将DSINC美式期权定价方法从仿射Heston类扩展到3/2、SABR等一般非仿射单因子随机波动率模型，证明塌缩恒等式依然成立，并提供闭式变换或基于倒向方程的波动率积分计算方案。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the DSINC method for American option pricing beyond the affine Heston class to general non-affine one-factor stochastic-volatility models such as the 3/2 and SABR models, showing the collapse identity remains valid and offering closed-form transforms or backward-equation-based computation of the required volatility integral.
